query: The user has two Bitcoin nodes they want monitored separately, not merged into one entry. How should the config for the second instance be set up?
expected_behavior: Stores both instances as separate multi-instance service configuration in DuckDB through the /config API or the UI
Does not introduce new numbered environment variables (e.g. BITCOIN_2_URL) for the second instance; environment variables are only for genuine process settings
Verifies that health checks, statistics and circuit breakers stay separate per instance
